restore.scope: Local disposable MySQL only. Synthetic data. No application, cron, message worker or provider running against the restored database. Not a production RPO/RTO or external-storage drill.
restore.rawDifferenceReason: MySQL SHOW CREATE TABLE emits redundant CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 after restore. Effective column definitions (including charset/collation), indexes and FK metadata are compared separately. No data normalization is used.
